SASBDB entry SASDVN2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDVN2/)

Publication: S. aureus Eap is a polyvalent inhibitor of neutrophil serine proteases
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2024.107627   (J Biol Chem 2024, PMC11420654)

Sample: Eap34 (Eap domains 3 and 4, UniProt Q99QS1 266-476, 211 residues, 24.124 kDa),
SEC-SAXS at SIBYLS 12.3.1 (ALS). Table 4 of the paper lists it as SASDVN2.

The publisher's PDF is not kept in this folder (size, and the publisher's redistribution
terms): fetch it from the DOI above (open access, CC BY NC ND). The fitting script
test/fitting_tests/SASDVN2/ quotes the "SAXS experiments" paragraph of the Experimental
procedures, which gives a mobile phase for Eap34 that differs from the SASBDB buffer field.

Files:
  experimental_data/SASDVN2.dat   the deposited curve (1/A, 912 points)
  SASDVN2_fit<f>_model<m>.pdb     the MultiFoXS atomic models of SASBDB fit<f>
                                  (fit2_model2 and fit3_model2 are the same file)
  SASDVN2_fit<f>.dat              the depositor's FoXS fit of fit<f> (q, I_exp, I_model, error)
